findings.title: SQL injection in order lookup
findings.description: The id query parameter reaches a SQL string.

evidence.analysis:
CWE: CWE-89

The handler concatenates the parameter into the query.

impact.rationale: Any unauthenticated caller can read the orders table.

findings.title: SQL injection (second report of the same line)
Reflected XSS in the search view
findings.description: The query is written into the page unescaped.

evidence.analysis:
CWE: CWE-79

The value is passed to innerHTML.

findings.title: Weak hash for session ids
findings.description: MD5 is used for a session id.

findings.title: Secrets in repository history
findings.description: A token-like string appears in a past commit.
